AboutSection.title: A Bit About Me
AboutSection.p1: I'm a software developer who thrives on understanding the "why"—the deep user and business needs behind every feature. My motto is "what you can measure, you can control," and I apply that by writing <teal>clean, efficient</teal>, and team-friendly code.
AboutSection.p2: While I'm a front-end specialist who loves a <magenta>good design challenge</magenta> (especially pixel-perfect UIs), I'm also a curious problem-solver who enjoys tackling HackerRank puzzles.
AboutSection.p3: As a BCIT-trained developer based in Vancouver, I'm looking for a role with clear goals on a collaborative team of smart, passionate people. I'm excited to grow, learn, and build <teal>scalable</teal>, <magenta>user-centric</magenta> applications.
